content.short: Atlantis Impact Miner is a collective working together to create tools on climate x sustainability.
content.description: Atlantis is a cooperative organization dedicated to fostering effective and credible climate action through community-driven initiatives. To advance this aim, it has built two core platforms. The Atlantis Impact Miner app invites individuals to participate in climate-based bounties, offering rewards upon successful completion. Foundry serves organizational needs by enabling transparent deployment of funds toward investments with a climate focus, providing clarity about where resources go and how they are used.
content.meta: Atlantis Impact Miner builds community tools focused on climate action and sustainability. Discover Atlantis Impact Miner and other Web3 Social Dapps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
